tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool, lightly tinted off-white; never pure white behind content.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Instrument surfaces: the ranking ledger, panels, tables.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Control rails and recessed wells (slider tracks, segmented control ground).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Blue-black text and primary marks on canvas, paper and sunken (15:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: leads, descriptions, captions on canvas, paper and sunken (6.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and metadata on paper and canvas only (4.9:1 on canvas). Never below 12px.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ink panels and on cobalt fills (15:1 on ink).

tokens.name: on-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink panels (9.6:1 on ink). Never on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-raised
tokens.usage: A raised cell inside an ink panel (the data inspector's metric tiles).

tokens.name: rule-on-ink
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside an ink panel. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate regions. Decorative only: never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Row separators inside a table or ledger.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, segmented controls and unselected chips: 4.1:1 on paper, 3.5:1 on sunken, so every field edge reaches 3:1.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: Untracked slopegraph paths and rank ticks: context, always paired with a numeric rank.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Interaction accent: primary buttons, links, active navigation, slider thumbs, hover on paths. White text on it (7.2:1).

tokens.name: cobalt-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of cobalt fills and links.

tokens.name: cobalt-wash
tokens.usage: Hover wash on interactive rows; cobalt and ink text stay legible on it.

tokens.name: sunflower
tokens.usage: Signal, used as a highlighter: the tracked item, rising positions, the focus halo. Ink on it (10.5:1); never as text or a lone line on paper (1.5:1). Same value as Tournesol's brand yellow and its largely_recommended criterion.

tokens.name: sunflower-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the selected row and of a live readout; ink and sunflower-ink read on it.

tokens.name: sunflower-ink
tokens.usage: Text that belongs to the signal (a rise, a highlighted figure) on paper or sunflower-wash (6.5:1). Tournesol's own text-on-yellow brown.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only, always with an icon and a sentence (6.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of an error message; danger and ink text on it.

tokens.name: metric-popularity
tokens.usage: Popularity (YouTube views) in composition bars. Deliberately neutral: audience is not quality. Always labelled.

tokens.name: crit-largely-recommended
tokens.usage: Tournesol score (largely_recommended) in composition bars and criterion marks. Value from tournesol-app/tournesol frontend/src/utils/criteria.ts.

tokens.name: crit-reliability
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion reliability. Criterion marks only, with its label.

tokens.name: crit-importance
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion importance. Criterion marks only, with its label.

tokens.name: crit-engaging
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion engaging. Criterion marks only, with its label.

tokens.name: crit-pedagogy
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion pedagogy. Criterion marks only, with its label.

tokens.name: crit-layman-friendly
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion layman_friendly. Criterion marks only, with its label.

tokens.name: crit-diversity-inclusion
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion diversity_inclusion; also the lab's diversity metric in composition bars.

tokens.name: crit-backfire-risk
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion backfire_risk. Criterion marks only, with its label.

tokens.name: crit-better-habits
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion better_habits. Criterion marks only, with its label.

tokens.name: crit-entertaining-relaxing
tokens.usage: Tournesol criterion entertaining_relaxing. Criterion marks only, with its label.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Qui décide ce que vous voyez ?
styles.usage: One per page, the page question. 36px under 720px.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Inspector headings, card titles, item titles in the ledger.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Même catalogue, autre règle : regardez ce qui monte.
styles.usage: The one-paragraph lead under a page title, in ink-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Chaque stratégie trie les mêmes contenus selon ses règles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Score calculé, non comparable d’une stratégie à l’autre.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels, buttons, chips. Sentence case.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Small labels: section labels, table heads, slot names, status stamps. Body face, sentence case, never tracked capitals. Never above a heading as an eyebrow.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one headline measure of a panel (rank movement, positions changed).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Ranks, scores, counts and dates anywhere they appear. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a figure and its unit; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Ledger row padding; control groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between instrument columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gutter on desktop; space between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom breathing room on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default: panels, ledger, tables, buttons are square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Small controls: chips, inputs, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Markers only: rank dots, slider thumbs, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The only shadow: a sheet that slides over content on phones.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Ledger row height on desktop; also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: row-touch
tokens.usage: Ledger row height on phones (two-line titles).

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the controls rail in the laboratory.

tokens.name: inspector
tokens.usage: Width of the inspector column in the laboratory.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for reading text.

tokens.name: move
tokens.usage: Rows and paths travelling to a new rank. Zero under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: settle
tokens.usage: Hover, selection and highlight changes.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: How long the previous position of the tracked item stays visible after a change.
